packaging_defect_demo_source_import: pack_complete_asr_delivery.sh strips internal imports only from DeviceStressTest.ets and ModelLoadBench.ets. MindirProbe.ets was added on 2026-10-08 (commit c0dec403), one day after the 0.3.20 delivery that last ran this check, and brought a third internal import nobody strips. Fixed after this package was frozen: the packer now transforms MindirProbe.ets as well and fails the pack if any delivered .ets still imports 'amphion_asr'. The 0.3.23 ZIP cannot be re-cut without a new source commit (the packer pins SOURCE_COMMIT to HEAD and the release SDK's provenance to the same commit), so this package ships with the defect and the customer-facing docs state the one-line workaround.
demo_source_build_method_note: Two environment facts cost time and are worth recording. (1) The CLT bundles node v24.14.1, which ignores NODE_PATH, so hvigor's own plugin-resolution mechanism (project_caches/<id>/workspace/node_modules via NODE_PATH) silently fails and every hvigor invocation dies with "Cannot find module '@ohos/hvigor-ohos-plugin'"; provisioning node_modules/@ohos/{hvigor,hvigor-ohos-plugin} next to the CLT hvigor root fixes it. (2) deviceInfo.ODID is regenerated when the demo is uninstalled, so any locally issued licence stops matching and setLicense returns 1002200033; hdc install over an existing install preserves the ODID, an uninstall does not. Verified by reinstalling the known-good diagnostics HAP, which failed identically.
